title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals: Reprised!
original_title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals: Reprised!
overview: Return to the terrifying town of Hatchetfield in this remounted production of the 2018 StarKid hit. Directed by Lauren Lopez, this new version of "The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals" is filled with chills, thrills and show stoppin' numbers.
